# Variable `SITEINFO_ENDIANNESS`

## Yocto Project Reference Manual

Specifies the endian byte order of the target system. The value should be either “le” for little-endian or “be” for big-endian.

Source: https://docs.yoctoproject.org/scarthgap/ref-manual/variables.html#term-SITEINFO_ENDIANNESS
